相同两组合各一次；碗与抓取通过，酒瓶追旧首点停滞、灶台残余旧路径阻断，归位均未启动。
零动作静态复核揭示旧目标回追危险及过严逐点门槛；未证明新反馈退离的物理效果。

hypothesis: 每周期从实测位姿生成短退离命令，去除逐点关节到位门槛并允许受筛查的换向，可解决追旧目标造成的停滞。
information_gain: 新退离实现的两条在线组合试点；旧碗、抓取、检查器与归位固定，区分实际退离动作、换向、最终间隙、归位和任务保留。不作为同随机流配对或总体可靠性估计。
success_criteria: 首碗仍按原实现通过才执行第二技能。第二技能Qwen达到收尾条件后必须进入measured_pose_feedback并实际movement>0；去除中间0.004rad门槛，实测位移至少3cm、当前CAD手部间隙>=1cm且实测开口/停稳后进入原home；收尾后用户目标、前碗成果、无持物/手接触/原home独立五连通过。
failure_criteria: 应触发但新退离零动作时停止该例依赖归位并记目标未验证；实际退离后仍无进展、无安全替代路线、目标丢失、或原归位未执行/未到位分阶段保留失败。
unknown_criteria: 视觉null/协议失败/初始化不明停止并保留错误；未启动不计VLA失败；只有视觉定位关联并非真机RGBD六维估计。

changed_factors.name: retreat_controller
changed_factors.before: 2mm fixed waypoints with joint error<=0.004 before advance; stalled40 stops
changed_factors.after: 8mm lookahead from measured encoder FK each cycle; actual progress/clearance; max3 screened alternate replans
changed_factors.reason: 解除逐点死锁并避免回追已不适合当前姿态的旧目标

changed_factors.name: retreat_screen_scope
changed_factors.before: remaining fixed route rescreen from actual pose back to old first target
changed_factors.after: each fresh local command screened with intermediate endpoint requirement deferred until full exit; final hand clearance and original home protection retained
changed_factors.reason: 短退离无需每一步已完全离开；接近障碍的路径规则仍保留

fixed_factors.home: same home controller/streaming .01rad kp50 max360 five samples and exact-open entry
fixed_factors.checker: unchanged user-approved generic prompt; current wrist+side and synchronized encoder; 150/300 actual VLA actions
fixed_factors.environment: goal_table LIBERO goal8, Panda robosuite/MuJoCo seed0 init0 one reset per sequence
fixed_factors.policy: same pretrained SmolVLA weights, no training or environment reset between subtasks
fixed_factors.comparison: historical condition reference only; policy random stream not paired
fixed_factors.bowl: feedback flag disabled for bowl; original successful release/retreat/home unchanged
fixed_factors.grasp: previous validated wine assist and visual association unchanged

scope.stop_rule: 两组合各一次；首碗不通过停止第二任务及另一组合。酒瓶检查未触发/新退离零动作停止本例下游，不用归位替代退离验证；已完成首碗时灶台为独立故障试点可继续。最多3次单次收尾内重规划、最多480退离动作；失败不现场重跑，不扩大，不微调，不开子agent。

bowl_wine.request: 先将碗放到盘子上，再将酒瓶放到架子上。

bowl_stove.request: 先将碗放到盘子上，再打开灶台。

configuration.check_schedule: actual VLA150/300; local grasp counted separately
configuration.home: original streaming, .01rad waypoints, kp50, max360, five ready samples
configuration.execution: primary agent + local tools; explicit user no-subagent instruction, no model effort override claimed
configuration.saved_negative_status: failed and unresolved; retained as prior risk, not a pass
configuration.authorization: latest user authorizes fixes and two small sequences, no subagents/no training
configuration.wine_helper: collision_grasp unchanged validated three-waypoint side grasp
configuration.pregrasp: qwen3-vl-plus, temperature0, thinking false, max1 call; no simulator pose in prompt; projected association tolerance .03 normalized
configuration.geometry_source: precise pose, orientation and contact protection remain simulator geometry; real RGBD estimation deferred
configuration.release: turn-only measured/half/open shape-screened concurrent opening after stationary20 exhausted; exact home gate unchanged
configuration.retreat: pilot wine/stove only: measured-pose 8mm lookahead; cloud refresh10; short path .003rad CAD sampling; no intermediate endpoint gate; final >=3cm travel +1cm clearance; <=3 alternative replans, max480 movement; final opening/settling then unchanged home

repeat.reason: new measured-pose retreat implementation; previously untested
